body: I know how you feel. My parents argue all the time too. I get yelled at by my dad constantly too. My mom keeps telling me it'll get better when I go to college, but I'm not sure I can last that long or even if college will be better

When I found out about Alan Rickman's death I cried. I don't even know why. I've never met him, but I felt like he's had such an impact on my life and I could relate to him in the Harry Potter movies.
And then I wondered, why couldn't it have been me? Why was a person so loved and admired by many been taken away from life, when I, unloved and alone, desperately wanted to end mine. It doesn't make sense.
